text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, Trainer...! Take a look at this 
storyboard...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I finished a new piece last night! In my 
next race, I make a sweeping run from the 
far outside on the fourth corner! It's a 
shocking development—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't an insanely early move from the 
backstretch be super thrilling? ...An 
outrageously early "gamble"— can my body 
take it, pushing right to the absolute 
limit?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, Trainer! Just a second! Could you 
wait just a teeeeny bit!? I just came up 
with the absolute best plot twist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll fix it right away!! P-Please wait! 
—It'll only take a second!
